description: This file contains functions for managing model aliases, including listing, adding, and removing aliases, with external dependencies for configuration, logging, and runtime management.

methods.name: modelsAliasesListCommand
methods.description: Lists all model aliases, outputting in JSON, plain text, or formatted list based on options.

methods.name: modelsAliasesAddCommand
methods.description: Adds or updates an alias for a model, resolving the model target and updating configuration.

methods.name: modelsAliasesRemoveCommand
methods.description: Removes an alias from the model configuration, or reports if not found.
